nina (People Ops): Quick request 1 1 Were running a Manager Spotlight Shelf in 4 offices next month. Need help assembling 80 shelf-kits and prepping 30 solo remote parcels. Volunteers for Thurs AM packing? Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

omar (Warehouse): I can reserve space and two pack tables. How big are the shelf-kits?

cheshire (Design): Each kit = 1 plaque, 2 small stickers, 1 handwritten note, 1 mini plant-pog. Photos in the sheet.

nina (People Ops): Thanks! Target per-kit cost $9. Remote parcels get a $8 e-gift and note.

paul (Finance): Approve up to $1,000 from culture fund. Please upload vendor receipts to the sheet under 'invoices'.

rachel (Remote Ops): I can batch-send the e-gifts if I get CSV by Wed noon. Also need timezone-safe delivery window.

omar (Warehouse): Volunteers: I have 3 warehouse temps. Need 4 more. Who can join Thurs 9-11am? @here

cheshire (Design): I'll drop off printed plaques Wed afternoon. Can we have a proofread on the note? I drafted: "Thanks for shining a light on your team." Thoughts?

nina (People Ops): I like it. Slight edit: "Thanks for shining a light on your team 1 Redwood appreciates you." Approved.

paul (Finance): Add small internal note on packing slip: "GL 4-215 1 culture expenses, retain receipts."

supply-bot: Reminder set: "Shelf-kit packing Thurs 9am".

rachel (Remote Ops): CSV ready after names finalized. Will DM confirmations.

nina (People Ops): Great work. I'll update the sheet with final counts and post final packing checklist tomorrow morning. Big thanks :clap:
